title: Improve Dedicated Fleet Autoscaler: burst controls, throughput guarantees and utilization reporting (v5)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers require predictable throughput and well-bounded burst behavior. Previous fleets showed oscillation during short traffic spikes and lacked per-fleet burst accounting for billing/alerts. This PR implements: 1) a configurable burst budget that decays over time, 2) throughput guarantee enforcement at the fleet level (soft guarantees + graceful degradation), and 3) per-fleet utilization and burst reporting exported to Prometheus and the Console. Changes are backward compatible for existing fleet configs; defaults maintain previous behavior unless explicit burst policy is set. Summary of changes: - autoscaler: add burst_budget and burst_window config, track budget consumption per-fleet, decay logic; introduce guaranteed_tps with soft-throttle path - scheduler: integrate burst-aware allocation so short spikes can borrow capacity without triggering scale-up immediately - metrics: new Prometheus metrics (fleet_burst_budget_remaining, fleet_burst_consumed_total, fleet_guaranteed_tps, fleet_utilization_percent) and Console dashboards/templates - reporting: daily and 1h utilization aggregates emitted to billing pipeline for cost/alerting - tests: unit + integration tests simulating spike patterns and verifying graceful degradation and budget decay - docs: dedicated autoscaling doc updated with examples and upgrade notes Checklist: [x] design review (ENG-1245) [x] unit tests [x] integration tests in perf-canary [x] console dashboard changes [x] docs update Rollout plan: feature-gate off by default; enable for canary fleets for 48h, observe metrics and SLOs, then staged enablement. If regressions observed, revert gate to previous behavior. Backwards compatibility: config fields are additive and optional; existing fleets continue to use legacy autoscaler behavior. Breaking change: none.

release_notes: Added per-fleet burst controls and utilization reporting. New config options: burst_budget, burst_window, guaranteed_tps. New Prometheus metrics: fleet_burst_budget_remaining, fleet_burst_consumed_total, fleet_guaranteed_tps, fleet_utilization_percent. Backwards compatible; feature gated off by default.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated off in main. To enable: set feature_gate.dedicated_burst = true in control plane and update helm values with desired burst_budget/burst_window. Recommended canary: enable for single small fleet for 48h and monitor fleet_burst_budget_remaining and SLO error rate.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover budget arithmetic and scheduler integration. Perf-canary ran three spike scenarios (single short spike, repeated microbursts, sustained ramp) and verified no oscillation and expected budget drain/refill behavior. Integration tests validate expected Prometheus metrics and daily aggregates emitted to billing pipeline.
known_issues: When guaranteed_tps approaches cluster capacity, soft-throttle increases 95th pct latency for non-guaranteed fleets; documented mitigation is to reserve headroom via provisioning or lower guarantees.
Very high cardinality metrics can increase cardinality for Prometheus; use metrics relabeling in production
